name: Birthday cake
about: A giant cake with pink and white layers, a cherry on top and four candles.

layers.name: Bottom layer
layers.tip: A square of pink wool, 5 by 5.

layers.name: Cream
layers.tip: A square of white wool for the cream.

layers.name: Icing
layers.tip: White wool on top for the icing.

layers.name: Cherry and candles
layers.tip: A red wool cherry in the middle, and four torches around it for candles.
